reconstructed_captions.3: The fireball expands rapidly, engulfing the entire grove of trees.
reconstructed_captions.4: A shockwave radiates outwards from the explosion, kicking up dust from the ground.
reconstructed_captions.5: The fireball begins to rise, transforming into a large column of smoke and fire.
reconstructed_captions.6: The column of smoke and fire climbs higher into the sky, churning violently.
reconstructed_captions.7: The smoke cloud continues to expand, darkening the sky around the explosion site.
reconstructed_captions.8: Debris from the explosion can be seen raining down around the blast zone.
reconstructed_captions.9: The massive smoke plume dominates the aerial view, still churning with energy.
reconstructed_captions.10: The fire within the smoke cloud starts to diminish, leaving a thick, dark cloud.
reconstructed_captions.11: The smoke cloud continues to billow upwards and outwards, covering a wide area.
reconstructed_captions.12: The aerial camera holds its position, showing the full extent of the smoke cloud.
reconstructed_captions.13: The smoke begins to drift slowly with the wind, away from the blast site.
reconstructed_captions.14: The landscape below is completely obscured by the dense, spreading smoke.
reconstructed_captions.15: The smoke cloud starts to thin slightly at the edges as it drifts.
reconstructed_captions.16: The aerial view shows the large, dark smoke cloud hanging over the landscape.
reconstructed_captions.17: The smoke continues to dissipate and drift, revealing the scarred earth where the trees were.
